manifest.name: doc-write
manifest.description: Document authoring pipeline: outline → write → review, with validation.

spec.goal: Write a document about {{subject}} to {{doc_path}} in style: {{style}}

nodes.task: Draft a section outline for a document about {{subject}} in this style: {{style}}. Return the outline only.
Write the document to {{doc_path}}, following the supplied outline and using this style: {{style}}.
Read {{doc_path}} and review it against the outline. Check internal consistency, completeness, and whether it matches this style: {{style}}. Return a checklist verdict and required fixes.

intent: Author a document in the workspace, validate that it exists, and review the result.
